recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-19433 unless a future publisher change stops honoring source/mappingSpaces.xml link overrides.
issue_request: FHIR-19433 is a Published/Persuasive PA correction for the former ProductPlan/current InsurancePlan mapping page. It reported that the link from insuranceplan-mappings.html#w5 to http://hl7.org/fhir/fivews returned a 404; the Jira resolution says the problem was corrected in a previous release.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-19433 was found. Git history shows fc4ada0543, 'GF#18326 - fix mapping spaces links', added an explicit source/mappingSpaces.xml link from http://hl7.org/fhir/fivews to http://hl7.org/fhir/fivews.html, which is the shared correction needed for this issue.
additional_context: InsurancePlan is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini and its StructureDefinition still uses the canonical FiveWs mapping URI. source/mappingSpaces.xml is the shared mapping-space input and now supplies fivews.html as the rendered link target. PA 2021-08-11 minutes record FHIR-19433 as true, persuasive, and approved 3-0-0. Current build.fhir.org renders the InsurancePlan #w5 mapping link to fivews.html, and no Zulip evidence was found that changes the conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already preserves the canonical mapping URI while providing the working hyperlink used by the rendered InsurancePlan mappings page, so editing InsurancePlan's mapping URI would be unnecessary and potentially less correct.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-18326 is a separate Published v2 mapping-link issue whose documented commit fc4ada0543 corrected shared mapping-space links, including the FiveWs link relevant to FHIR-19433; it was not decided here.
